segment.source: Renders several passages of text as tabs, one panel visible at a time and the rest a single click away. Use it for: instructions that differ by operating system, a product described for two audiences, prices per region, specifications by model, the same answer for private and business customers. Prefer 'Accordion' when the panels are a list a reader works through, and 'Side-by-Side Texts' when two of them should be visible at once.
